name: SKOS (and SKOS-XL)
purpose: Concept schemes; labels; hierarchy; mapping relations (exact/close/broad/narrow/related)
fit_for_emst: High: the lowest-common-denominator semantics ESCO and CTDL already use; every export can be derived from it
notes: Canonical semantics for concepts and mapping predicates. Use SKOS-XL only if label-level provenance (who proposed which alt label) becomes necessary [J]

name: JSON-LD 1.1
purpose: Linked-data serialization of JSON
fit_for_emst: High: lets one JSON file be both a developer payload and RDF; language maps fit multilingual labels
notes: Native release format = JSON-LD bundle with a published context (emst.context.jsonld). Tested with pyld 3.3.0: 1424 triples from the 2-competency example

name: JSON Schema 2020-12
purpose: Structural validation of records
fit_for_emst: High: CI-enforceable; already used by OpenLMP
notes: Schema enforces ID pattern; provenance on every record; superseded-needs-replacedBy. Semantics live in SKOS/JSON-LD; structure in JSON Schema

name: SSSOM (Simple Standard for Sharing Ontological Mappings)
purpose: Mapping records with predicate; justification; confidence; author/reviewer; versions of both sides
fit_for_emst: High: the only mature open standard for mapping-level provenance; has semapv:LLMBasedMatching and reviewer_agreement
notes: All L6 crosswalks stored as SSSOM/TSV (one file per target and version). Pin to 1.0 slots now; adopt 1.1 slots (record_id; review_date; reviewer_agreement) as extensions until 1.1 is final

name: IEEE 1484.20.3-2022 Shareable Competency Definitions
current_version_date: Active; published 2023-07-27; amendment P1484.20.3a (Open Source) PAR 2025-06-19
purpose: Context-independent data model for competency definitions and frameworks incl. rubrics
fit_for_emst: Medium: right concepts but few public implementations seen; full text paywalled and not read
notes: Align EMST field names to it in documentation; publish an EMST application profile once 20.3a enables open supporting documents. Do not make it the serialization [J]

name: 1EdTech CASE 1.1
purpose: System-to-system exchange of standards/competency frameworks (CFDocument; CFItem; CFAssociation; CFRubric)
fit_for_emst: Medium-High for academia and learning systems; low for HR. Association vocabulary is coarser than SKOS (no close/broad/narrow)
notes: Export profile for LC and LMS/assessment vendors. UUIDv5 of EMST IRIs as CASE identifiers. Field names in the example are from CASE 1.0 knowledge plus the 1.1 change list; validate against 1EdTech JSON Schema before certification

name: CASE Network 2 (registry)
